[[File:Dale Maurice DecipherCon 1999.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Dale Maurice at DecipherCon 1999. Photo: Decipher.]]
'''Dale Maurice''' programmed the [[Star Wars CCG Palace]] with [[Calvin Sanders]] and walked the site at the 14 March 1997 Grand Opening party.<ref name="party">[http://rothko.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/index.html Special Events], Decipher (March 1997). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19970327205534/http://rothko.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/index.html Internet Archive]</ref> At [[DecipherCon 1999]] Decipher photographed him and Sanders, as web programmers, watching the DecipherCon message boards.<ref name="fri38">[http://www.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/photos/FRI/fri38.html DecipherCon 1999 Friday photo fri38], Decipher (1999). Caption: "Web programmers Dale Maurice and Calvin Sanders keep a watch on DecipherCon Message Boards". Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20000610234126/http://www.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/photos/FRI/fri38.html Internet Archive]</ref>
